Kerala High Court restricts Waqf Board decisions over member composition

The Kerala High Court has restrained the Kerala State Waqf Board from making major decisions, including policy and capital expenditure, due to concerns about its constitution. The court noted a prima facie absence of non-Muslim members, which it suggested might be contrary to legal requirements. This interim order impacts the board's ability to function until the composition issue is resolved.
